architecture: [4,32,128] KANLinear enc/dec on the (cos th, sin th, cos p, sin p) embedding + stable propagator expm(K - L^T L)
tau_axis_note: Prune-tau axis NOT run for the standard map. The paper's tau protocol (appendix Eq. edge-importance) is a PyKAN-style layerwise attribution on activation variance, B_ij = mean_k r_kij, applied to a PyKAN encoder. The committed standard-map encoder (results/standard_map/standard_map_stable_32_128.pt) is KANLinear (kan.py), which exposes no PyKAN activation graph and therefore no attribution scores; the KANLinear surrogate used for Ikeda (spline_weight magnitude) is a different score and would not be the same tau axis. Retraining a PyKAN [4,32,128] standard-map encoder purely to add this axis was judged out of scope: the tau axis is already covered on two systems (Lorenz tab:prune-sweep and Ikeda, results/ikeda_robustness/axis_tau.csv).
